name: stateward-vscode
description: Finds the cases your TypeScript, React and Python code does not handle, as you type, with the place, the reason and the fix.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: stateward runs the workspace's stateward config and server.

stateward.serverPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a language server to run instead of the project's `@stateward/language-server` and the bundled copy, for testing a clone of stateward (`/path/to/stateward/packages/language-server/dist/bin.js`). It overrides the project's server in every project. It is a machine setting, so it is in the User settings only. Empty (the default): the project's server, else the bundled copy.

stateward.inlayHints.throws.markdownDescription: Show `throws NotFoundError | ParseError` (and `rejects …`) after the signature of a function whose errors are known.

stateward.inlayHints.catchVariable.markdownDescription: Show the error classes the `try` can throw after the variable of a `catch (e)`, such as `: NotFoundError | ParseError | unknown`.

stateward.python.enabled.markdownDescription: Start the Python server (`py-stateward server`) for this folder even when its `pyproject.toml` has no `[tool.stateward]` table. A folder with that table gets one without this setting.

stateward.python.serverPath.markdownDescription: The `py-stateward` program to run, for example a build of your own. Empty: the project's environment (`.venv` or `venv`), then `PATH`. The extension never bundles py-stateward: install it in the project (`uv add --dev py-stateward` or `pip install py-stateward`).

stateward.python.pyrefly.markdownDescription: The Pyrefly program the Python server asks for types (`--pyrefly`). Empty: the server's own lookup (`PY_STATEWARD_PYREFLY`, `checker-path`, the project's environment, then `PATH`). A change restarts that folder's server.

stateward.python.checkerProcesses.markdownDescription: How many Pyrefly processes may answer the Python server at once (`--checker-processes`). One by default: your own Pyrefly already holds a copy of the project's types. A change restarts that folder's server.
